name: Delilah
source: A friend of Daring Academy's protagonist and Amelia Sweet. While she is the most mature out of the couple, Delilah is also the most loving one out of the two, caring for anyone she likes loves helping anyone whenever she can, like her catpanion. Delilah is in a relationship with Minty and lives on her own.
